SELECT
u.id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, u.created_at,
la.email
FROM users u LEFT OUTER JOIN local_accounts la ON u.id = la.user_id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe WHERE user_id = #{id}) AS my_recipe_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like WHERE user_id = #{id}) AS like_recipe_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_board WHERE users_id = #{id}) AS my_review_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_board_reply WHERE users_id = #{id}) AS my_reply_cnt FROM DUAL

SELECT
rb.id, rb.subject, rb.content, rb.image_url, rb.hit, rb.created_at, rb.rcp_seq,
r.rcp_nm, r.att_file_no_main,
u.id AS chef_id, u.nickname AS chef_nickname, u.profile_image_url AS chef_profile_image
FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN recipe r ON rb.rcp_seq = r.rcp_seq LEFT OUTER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE rb.users_id = #{id} ORDER BY rb.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, review_board_id, content, created_at FROM review_board_reply WHERE users_id = #{id} ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
